Our teams remain committed to providing expert, compassionate care when it matters most. We look forward to continuing to care for your pet across our Atlanta hospitals.
BluePearl Pet Hospital Westside – serving the Atlanta metro area.
We are located in west Midtown, offering pets and their families compassionate and expert veterinary care in the Atlanta metro area and many northern and central Georgia communities.
Our reviews.
Our services.
Our experienced team of veterinarians, vet technicians and support staff work closely together to provide the comprehensive, compassionate care your pet needs and deserves.
See Specialties and Services

veterinarians.
Caring for your pets is our passion. Meet our team of veterinarians here to help you and your pet.
See Veterinarians
About BluePearl Pet Hospital Westside Atlanta.
Our pet hospital opened in 2016 in the heart of bustling Midtown with quick access to GA State Road 400 and interstates 75 and 85.
Our highly-trained veterinarians use advanced equipment to diagnose and treat your pets. This includes a CT scanner for diagnostic imaging and specialized machines for use in cataract surgery for dogs and cats.
With seven exam rooms and two surgical suites, our clinic is a fully-equipped veterinary center providing superior veterinary medicine in Atlanta.
Pet owners.
At BluePearl, providing our customers with remarkable service is a top priority. We’re committed to making your veterinary visit as smooth as possible.
Have questions prior to your visit? We’re happy to help. Contact our hospital team at

or

Testimonials.
“In December, my cat, who was recovering from dental surgery, was not doing well. Three days after surgery, early Saturday morning, my local vet was closed, so I called Westside BluePearl. Everyone there was outstanding in their care and concern for my cat AND for me.
From Addy to Dr. Cordell, Ryan, and Veronica, I could not have asked for better care (and a couple of others whose names I forget). They all took extra time to help me work through the feeding tube process and answer all my panicky questions. Can’t say enough thank yous.”
— Lynn
“It seemed to happen so quickly and yet time stood still – my husband and I had to make the excruciating painful decision to humanely euthanize our big boy, Stevie – a grey 4 year old domestic short hair feline – but he was so much more to us, so much more.
I cannot begin to imagine going through this without Dr. Lewis and her staff. Thank you for being so patient (with us), so caring and loving with Stevie. The time we spent with you Dr. Lewis was relatively short, we were strangers but you helped us at our most vulnerable. With our utmost respect and admiration for all you do.”
— Elisheva and Betzalel
